newsitem.title: USA: Advanced NMR gets $5.1 mln GE investment.
newsitem.headline: Advanced NMR gets $5.1 mln GE investment.

text.p: Advanced NMR Systems Inc said Tuesday General Electric Co's GE Medical Systems invested $5.1 million in the company.

Chief executive Jack Nelson said in an interview GE bought $2.7 million of Advanced preferred stock, convertible at $0.233 per share, and used the balance to buy the company's 3-tesla and 4-tesla whole body magnetic resonance imaging business.
"This gives us a substantial cash reserve with almost no debt for future growth," Nelson said.

Advanced NMR said May 27 it would buy Advanced Mammography Systems Inc for $7.2 million in stock. It is now awaiting Securities and Exchange Commission clearance of proxy material and a related registration statement for subsequent approval of shareholders for the merger.
Its stock traded at 9/32 Tuesday morning, up 7/64.
